newsitem.title: USA: SUN MICROSYSTEMS SIGNS OEM DEAL WITH MADGE.
newsitem.headline: SUN MICROSYSTEMS SIGNS OEM DEAL WITH MADGE.

text.p: Madge Networks Inc, which provides networking solutions, said it signed an OEM agreement with Sun Microsystems Inc to sell a Madge-designed PCI Token Ring adapter.
This worldwide OEM agreement marks the first time the two companies have signed a contract of this kind, Madge said.

The adapter will be used with both the Sun Ultra 30 workstations and with Sun's server I/O boards for use in Ultra Enterprise Servers, Madge said. The Madge adapter lets the Sun Microsystems products connect to the Token Ring network sytem.
The OEM agreement is effective immediately and is part of an ongoing campaign by Madge to recruit allies and expand its market penetration and leadership in the Token Ring market, Madge said.
Shares of Madge Networks gained 13/16 to 6-7/8.
